text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED @raj_oncall @lina_sre - Severity: High. Sudden increase in generation failures and hallucinatory outputs observed for model rwd-model-3b-quant-v2 across chat routes beginning 2026-03-15T14:12:03Z. Drift metric +20% vs baseline.

raj_oncall: ack, joining. I see alert spikes across canary and partial prod. Timestamps line up with 14:10 deploy.

lina_sre: on infra. No node reboots or hardware errors. Notable: memory alloc patterns shifted during the 14:10 deploy.

tom_ml: investigating model artifacts. The new quant build b-20260315-q8-256 was promoted in the deploy; quantization step changed kernel ordering. Rolling eval shows token-level divergence.

julia_engineer: customers reporting truncated JSON outputs when using structured-output mode. Support queue has tickets 4521,4523,4527.

emily_prod: product impact: structured responses and function-calling callouts are noisy. Recommend immediate mitigation to reduce customer exposure.

raj_oncall: proposal: 1) route affected traffic to rwd-model-3b-stable (previous release) for /v1/generate routes; 2) mark offending artifact as blocked; 3) run automated diff on golden prompts. Who can execute the router change?

julia_engineer: I can execute with SRE. Please confirm percent and scope.

lina_sre: prefer 100% for affected route until we validate. We should avoid partial splits that keep customers impacted.

tom_ml: agree. Also start a regression job comparing q8-256 vs stable across enterprise prompt set.

incident-bot: NOTE: runbook step - when model quality regression occurs after deploy, pin to last-known-good model and add incident tag "model-quality_regression".

julia_engineer: running router command now with lina_sre in session:
```
routerctl set-route --service generate --model rwd-model-3b-stable --percent 100 --reason "emergency pin: quality regression after q8-256 promotion"
```

incident-bot: ACTION: router change executed by julia_engineer at 2026-03-15T14:18:05Z. Traffic for /v1/generate pinned to rwd-model-3b-stable.

qa_bot: quick eval: drift metric fell from +20% to +1.5% within 90s on golden prompt set. False-positive rate for structured outputs reduced by 85%.

support_lead: drafting customer-facing note: 
"We experienced a temporary degradation in model output quality beginning at ~14:10 UTC due to a model promotion. We've reverted affected traffic to a verified model and are monitoring. If you continue to see unexpected outputs, please provide examples and request IDs. We'll provide a technical update after our investigation."

emily_prod: good. Include next update ETA: 15:00 UTC. Add link to status page. Keep tone apologetic but concise.

incident-bot: DRAFT status page update created:
- Component: Chat Generation API
- Status: Degraded Performance -> Mitigated (traffic pinned)
- Impact: Some customers may have received incorrect or truncated outputs between 14:10-14:18 UTC.
- Mitigation: Traffic pinned to rwd-model-3b-stable. RCA in progress.

lina_sre: artifact b-20260315-q8-256 marked as blocked in artifact registry. Tom, can you capture the build diff and share?

tom_ml: pulling build logs now. Early sign: ordering of per-channel quant kernels differs which may shuffle dequant rounding in edge cases. Will upload detailed diff.

raj_oncall: decision log: do not trigger full rollback yet since pinning restored metrics. Blocking the artifact and preventing auto-promote should be sufficient for now. Schedule RCA.

julia_engineer: adding operational commands used to incident artifacts for traceability.

incident-bot: HANDOFF scheduled at 14:45 UTC. Primary owners: @lina_sre (infra), @tom_ml (ML RCA), @emily_prod (comms).

qa_bot: running extended regression across customer prompt samples. Preliminary numbers: truthfulness score back to 98% vs baseline 99%; failure cases concentrated on nested JSON outputs longer than 512 tokens.

support_lead: sending message to 12 affected accounts now. Will include request IDs and offer escalation path.

emily_prod: post-incident checklist:
1) Publish status page full update once RCA is available.
2) Send follow-up technical summary to impacted customers including timeline + mitigation.
3) Create postmortem doc and assign owners.
4) Add a deploy-gate comparing quantized build outputs on golden prompts before promotion.

tom_ml: creating ticket to add a gating job that runs a token-diff comparator for quantized builds. We should also add a threshold: if per-prompt token-diff > 5% across enterprise prompts, fail promotion.

lina_sre: infra action item: add an automated check that flags memory allocation pattern deviations during model load and quantization. Filing ticket.

raj_oncall: assigning postmortem owner = julia_engineer; RCA lead = tom_ml; comms lead = emily_prod/support_lead. Severity = Sev2.

julia_engineer: noted, beginning postmortem skeleton. Will include timeline, commands, blocked artifact id, and eval diffs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATE: mitigated (monitoring). Expected next update at 15:00 UTC or sooner if regression reappears.

lina_sre: closing urgent on-call paging. Will keep a watch on traces for 1 hour.

tom_ml: uploading build diff and regression outputs to incident artifacts now.

support_lead: final customer message sent and copied into incident. No escalations reported.

incident-bot: Thread archived at 2026-03-15T15:00:00Z. Reminder: attach postmortem link and severity tag in incident tracker when ready.
